verdict.rationale: MX ships a downloadable OpenAPI spec (and a public GitHub repo) that can be imported into Postman to explore requests/responses, but there is no evidence of a native interactive API reference with in-page 'try it now' runnable examples — a probe for a hosted openapi.json/swagger UI on the docs site returned 404s. missing for 10: an embedded interactive/try-it API console on docs.mx.com, evidence of runnable code examples in-browser, and independent confirmation of the Postman workflow's usability.
